Analytics Methodology & Technical Framework

The SupeRR Selector pressure analysis engine evaluates delivery-level performance against empirical expected-value baselines constructed from qualifying IPL and T20 matches (2022 onward). Matches are separated into three distinct tiers: SENIOR, DEVELOPMENT, and YOUTH, each evaluated on dedicated empirical baselines to prevent quality cross-contamination.

1. Expected-Value Baselines & Top 12 T20I Opponent Filter

Senior expected-value baselines across 408 game-state buckets built strictly from 179,336 qualifying deliveries (all 360 resolved IPL matches unfiltered + 397 resolved T20I matches against official ICC Top 12 opponents as of 2026-11-14: IND, AUS, ENG, SA, NZ, WI, PAK, SL, BAN, AFG, IRE, ZIM; 51 T20I matches vs non-Top 12 opponents dropped).

2. Pressure Definitions

Batters: 2nd innings deliveries with RRR ≥ 9.0 or death overs (overs 16-20 / balls rem ≤ 30) in either innings.
Bowlers: 2nd innings core chase band (RRR 8.0-12.0) and last-over component (balls rem 1-6). Balls in both count once exclusively in last-over.

3. Senior Ranking Sets & Eligibility Rules

Set 1 (RR Players): Filtered to players who appeared for Rajasthan Royals.
Set 2 (Next Season Eligible): Proxy pool of players who appeared in the most recent two seasons (2025 & 2026). Pakistan players excluded per IPL regulations.
Set 3 (All Senior Players): Full senior pool across qualifying matches.

4. Tiered Thresholds & Formulas

RR Players: Min 30 pressure balls (batters), 24 band balls (bowlers); shrinkage $k=30$ / $24$.
Non-RR Senior: Min 60 pressure balls (batters), 48 band balls (bowlers); shrinkage $k=60$ / $48$.
Formulas: Batters: $z(\text{Runs+ / 100}) - z(\text{Dismissal Penalty})$. Bowlers: $z(\text{Runs Saved}) + z(\text{Wicket Comp}) + 0.5 \times z(\text{Last-Over Comp})$.

5. Young & Development Tier Separation (Non-Comparable)

Young Players (Youth matches: Asia Cup Rising Stars 2025) and Development Players (Emerging matches: Mens T20 Emerging Teams Asia Cup 2024) are evaluated on a separate 217-bucket expected-value table (expected_tables_development.csv). Notice: Ratings are normalized strictly within each sub-list and are non-comparable to Senior ratings due to different competition baselines and opposition quality.
